description: Screen a name against sanctions lists, evaluate email deliverability and disposable signals, validate a phone number's numbering plan and inspect IP geography/network. Returns findings, per-check completion, and a screening risk indicator. Never proves document authenticity, ownership or liveness, and is NOT complete KYC or identity verification. Inconclusive/failed checks cannot produce a low-risk result. Input: any of name, email, phone, ip; optional country/birth_year. $0.10 per call.
name: hubvibe_contact_screen
title: Contact and sanctions screening (not identity verification)
